summary: This replication stage executed a thorough forensic investigation and partial computational reproduction of Paper P. The agent downloaded the MUSE vectors and reproduced the grammatical classifier accuracies (0.9140 ES / 0.8258 FR), direction cosine (0.3885), original MWEAT (3.6918 ES / 2.3437 FR), and Shift Ori MWEAT (0.3090 ES / 0.2446 FR) to four decimal places. It correctly identified major methodological defects, including the doPCA centering bug, the use of LinearSVC instead of LDA, and the statistical degeneracy of post-mitigation permutation p-values (showing p=0.000 by construction due to a point mass null). However, it left word translation unrun, only partially reproduced FR word-pair translation, and did not test several validity issues such as the masculine-only cue bias or circular mitigation evaluation.
